project.name: platform
project.description: What every module of the repository shares and PingFederate does not provide: a registry of what to close when a classloader's copy shuts down, the state of each component, a JDK-only JSON reader and writer, and - as Phase 2 lands them - settings, the deployment profile, events, metrics, health, Redis, outbound HTTP and managed executors. JDK only at runtime: no Jackson, jose4j, servlet API or PingFederate, so the servlets can stage it beside themselves and the plugins can shade and relocate it.
